_question: R4-W3 / R4-Q4: convert R3 TCB exposure ceilings into measured RP->V flips by deliberately injecting each single fault and re-scoring the 60-bug corpus.
interpretation: Each measured RP->V flip count is at most the exposure ceiling reported in R3, and is the actual number of bugs the fault would silence on the 60-bug corpus.  Tightening the F4 ceiling (7/60 exposure) to the measured flip quantifies the gap between exposure and load-bearing flip for the analyser handler.
